en: <CLT=cltMIND>It leads to the hidden room!

<CLT=cltMIND>The girls bathroom and the hidden room
in the library are connected...

The library isn't the only way to get in and
out of the hidden room...

<CLT=cltMIND>The hidden room had this secret
passageway leading out of it.

<CLT=cltMIND>And that passageway connects to the
girls bathroom on the first floor.
<CLT=cltMIND>But this passageway...
<CLT=cltMIND>wasn't on Rantaro's Survivor Perk map.

<CLT=cltMIND>This passageway was <CLT=cltSTRONG>hidden<CLT=cltMIND>,
even from him.

<CLT=cltMIND>A hidden passageway that only the
mastermind knows about.

A passageway connected to
the girls bathroom...

<CLT=cltSYSTEM>"<CLT=cltSTRONG>Hidden Room Passageway<CLT=cltSYSTEM>" has been added
to the Truth Bullets section of your Monopad.

Once more...I shall reveal the secret behind
my escape from the sealed room.
Yes, please do.

Right after you guys left this room, there was
a huge explosion and I got flipped over...
When I came to my senses...it looked like this.
I'm surprised you weren't hurt...
Since I've been using my magic a lot lately...

A magical backlash must have happened
and the way out got buried in rubble.

Even I, the wise and powerful Himiko, panicked
a little bit when I saw I was trapped in here.
What happened after that?

I banged on the walls and the floor and yelled
for help. Calmly and rationally, of course...
<CLT=cltMIND>...I'm sure.

Then, I happened to find that hidden 
pathway and that's how I got out...

Then I ran into Keebo and he told me you were 
in one of the classrooms on the 2nd floor...
So I rushed over there...

I see...so that's what happened.
I understand now.
W-Well? Was I...useful?
Huh?

<CLT=cltMIND>It seems Himiko is still
concerned about that...
W-Well? Was I...useful?

After all, I am the <CLT=cltSTRONG>Ultimate Mage<CLT=cltNORMAL>!
Hiii hee hee hee!
<CLT=cltMIND>I can't go back yet.
Yes
No
Are you unsure of something?
<CLT=cltSYSTEM>Would you like to leave?

<CLT=cltMIND>Rubble blocks the way into
the library.

<CLT=cltMIND>So you *have* to go through the hidden
passageway to get out of the hidden room.

<CLT=cltMIND>Motherkuma is lying on the ground,
likely due to the explosion.
Is it...broken?
...I'm busted.
Ahhh... It's over. I can't go on...

I can't birth Monokumas anymore...
I wanted to birth more and more and more...
<CLT=cltMIND>Birth Monokumas, huh?

Hey... Is it true that you can
make spare Monokumas?
O-Of course it's true...

Fine... Since this is the end for me, I guess
I'll say it..

I have a built-in voiceprint authentication
system...

I can't birth Monokumas unless the designated
person specifically says the word "birth"...
<CLT=cltMIND>"Designated person"?

It's to ensure that my Monokumas are birthed
into a welcoming environment, y'know?

W-Wait a minute, this "designated person"...
Do you mean the mastermind?

Only the mastermind's voice command
will make you create a spare Monokuma?

Puhu...puhuhu... Th-That hint was...on the
house, so to speak...
Ah-hahahaha! All glory to the killing game—!
H-Hey!
It seems like...it's really broken this time.
<CLT=cltMIND>That was an important clue.

<CLT=cltMIND>Motherkuma creates spare Monokumas after
receiving the mastermind's voice command.

<CLT=cltMIND>Motherkuma isn't moving at all.
She's really broken.
Still...we got an important clue.

Motherkuma "births" a spare Monokuma
with the mastermind's voice command.

<CLT=cltMIND>That passageway was a vital clue, in that it
led us here. There's nothing to check there.
<CLT=cltMIND>I should probably get out of here.

<CLT=cltMIND>If the entrance to the bathroom were blocked
by rubble, we'd be completely trapped.

Himiko, let's go. I have a good
idea of what's going on here.
Hm? Something wrong?
J-Just tell it to me straight...like a man.
...Tell you what?

The hidden pathway I found...
Is it a useful clue?
I-I want to be useful for my friends.

But I can't help much in investigations,
can I? I couldn't find the mastermind...
Ah, you're worried about that...

Himiko, not only were you *useful*, you
may have cracked the case wide open.

Really!? If I found such an amazing clue,
that's proof I'm no ordinary person!

Hiii hee hee hee!
I'm terrified of my own magical power!

R-Right...
Let's get out of here.
